nodes.label: MRAgent: Memory is Reconstructed, Not Retrieved
nodes.author: Shuo Ji, Yibo Li, Bryan Hooi
nodes.rationale: Framework combining associative memory graph with active reconstruction mechanism where LLM reasoning integrates directly into memory access, enabling dynamic adaptation to intermediate evidence during inference.

nodes.label: MRAgent System
nodes.rationale: Memory Reasoning Architecture for LLM Agents: performs active and associative memory reconstruction by exploring multiple candidate retrieval paths, pruning irrelevant branches based on intermediate evidence.

nodes.label: Cue–Tag–Content Memory Graph
nodes.rationale: Heterogeneous graph where cues are fine-grained keywords, contents store memory items, and tags encode associative relations; enables two-stage retrieval where LLM first selects tags then retrieves content.

nodes.label: Active Memory Reconstruction Paradigm
nodes.rationale: Transforms memory access from one-shot retrieval into active multi-step reconstruction process that progressively reveals information; integrates LLM reasoning directly into memory access for dynamic strategy adaptation.

nodes.label: Multi-Granular Memory Layers
nodes.rationale: Episodic layer stores event-specific information; semantic layer captures stable knowledge; abstraction layer summarizes recurring patterns; enables flexible combination of evidence at different granularities.

hyperedges.label: MRAgent Memory Architecture
hyperedges.rationale: Integrated memory system combining structured graph representation, active reasoning-driven traversal, and multi-level abstraction for long-horizon memory reasoning
